name: Fortifying Brew
description: Turns your skin to stone for 15 sec.

name: Invoke Xuen, the White Tiger
description: Summons an effigy of Xuen, the White Tiger for 20 sec. Xuen attacks your primary target, and strikes 3 enemies within 10 yards every 0.9 sec with Tiger Lightning for 8 Nature damage.

name: Celestial Conduit
description: The August Celestials empower you, causing you to radiate 387 Nature damage onto enemies and 20,555 healing onto up to 5 injured allies within 15 yds over 3.6 sec, reduced beyond 5 targets.\n\nYou may move while channeling, but casting other healing or damaging spells cancels this effect.

name: Paralysis
description: Incapacitates the target for 1 min. Limit 1. Damage may cancel the effect.

name: Slicing Winds
description: Envelop yourself in razor-sharp winds, then lunge forward dealing 156 Nature damage to enemies in your path. Damage reduced beyond 5 enemies.\n\nHold to increase lunge distance.

name: Tiger's Lust
description: Increases a friendly target's movement speed by 70% for 6 sec and removes all roots and snares.

name: Fists of Fury
description: Pummels all targets in front of you, dealing 456 Physical damage to your primary target and 274 damage to all other enemies over 3.6 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets. Can be channeled while moving.

name: Zenith
description: Chi costs are reduced by 1 and Blackout Kick reduces the cooldown of affected abilities by an additional 1 sec for 15 sec.\n\nActivating Zenith resets the remaining cooldown on Rising Sun Kick.

name: Spear Hand Strike
description: Jabs the target in the throat, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 5 sec.

name: Rising Sun Kick
description: Kick upwards, dealing 49 Physical damage.

name: Transcendence
description: Split your body and spirit, leaving your spirit behind for 15 min. Use Transcendence: Transfer to swap locations with your spirit.

name: Detox
description: Removes all Poison and Disease effects from the target.

name: Diffuse Magic
description: Activating Fortifying Brew transfers all currently active harmful magical effects on you back to their original caster if possible.

name: Soothing Mist
description: Heals the target for 6,386 over 7.1 sec. While channeling, Enveloping Mist and Vivify may be cast instantly on the target.

name: Ring of Peace
description: Form a Ring of Peace at the target location for 5 sec. Enemies that enter will be ejected from the Ring.

name: Strike of the Windlord
description: Strike with both fists at all enemies in front of you, dealing 529 Physical damage and reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec. Deals reduced damage to secondary targets.

name: Whirling Dragon Punch
description: Performs a devastating whirling upward strike, dealing 252 damage to all nearby enemies and an additional 157 damage to the first target struck. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.\n\nOnly usable while both Fists of Fury and Rising Sun Kick are on cooldown.

name: Song of Chi-Ji
description: Conjures a cloud of hypnotic mist that slowly travels forward. Enemies touched by the mist fall asleep, Disoriented for 20 sec.

name: Chi Torpedo
description: Torpedoes you forward a long distance and increases your movement speed by 30% for 10 sec, stacking up to 2 times.

name: Disable
description: Reduces the target's movement speed by 50% for 15 sec, duration refreshed by your melee attacks.

name: Touch of Death
description: You exploit the enemy target's weakest point, instantly dealing damage equal to 100% of your maximum health to them.\n\nOnly usable on creatures that have less health than you.

name: Touch of Fatality
description: Instantly kills any creature under level 50, or player under 20% health.

name: Leg Sweep
description: Knocks down all enemies within 6 yards, stunning them for 3 sec.

name: Zen Pilgrimage
description: Your spirit travels to your home temple, leaving your body behind. \n\nUse Zen Pilgrimage again to return back to near your departure point.

name: Expel Harm
description: Expel negative chi from your body, healing for 467 and dealing 10% of the amount healed as Nature damage to an enemy within 20 yards.

name: Provoke
description: Taunts the target to attack you, and increases the threat you generate against them by 800% for 6 sec.

name: Blackout Kick
description: Kick with a blast of Chi energy, dealing 30 Physical damage.

name: Roll
description: Roll a short distance.

name: Chi Burst
description:
Hurls a torrent of Chi energy up to 40 yds forward, dealing 98 Nature damage to all enemies, and 77 healing to the Monk and all allies in its path. Healing and damage reduced beyond 5 targets.


Casting Chi Burst does not prevent avoiding attacks.

name: Chi Wave
description: Every 15 sec, your next Rising Sun Kick or Vivify releases a wave of Chi energy that flows through friends and foes, dealing 6 Nature damage or 20 healing. Bounces up to 7 times to targets within 25 yards.

name: Crackling Jade Lightning
description: Channel Jade lightning, causing 9 Nature damage over 3.6 sec to the target and sometimes knocking back melee attackers.

name: Flying Serpent Kick
description: Soar forward through the air at high speed for 1.5 sec.\n \nIf used again while active, you will land, reducing the movement speed of enemies within 8 yds by 70% for 4 sec.

name: Healing Sphere
description: When you kill an enemy, you summon a Healing Sphere, healing you for 69 when you walk through it.

name: Renewing Mist
description: Surrounds the target with healing mists, restoring 837 health over 20 sec.\n\nIf Renewing Mist heals a target past maximum health, it will travel to another injured ally within 20 yds.

name: Resuscitate
description: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 35% of maximum health and mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

name: Sheilun's Gift
description: Draws in all nearby clouds of mist generated by Sheilun, healing the target for 190 per cloud absorbed.

name: Single-Button Assistant
description: Casts damaging abilities for use in combat, rotating through them based on priority.\n\nThe global cooldown of abilities used through the Single-Button Assistant is 25% longer.

name: Spinning Crane Kick
description: Spin while kicking in the air, dealing 14 Physical damage over 1.3 sec to all enemies within 8 yds. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

name: Tiger Palm
description: Strike with the palm of your hand, dealing 31 Physical damage.

name: Touch of Karma
description: Absorbs all damage taken for 10 sec, up to 50% of your maximum health, and redirects 70% of that amount to the enemy target as Nature damage over 6 sec.

name: Vivify
description: Causes a surge of invigorating mists, healing the target for 959.

name: Zen Flight
description: You fly through the air at a quick speed on a meditative cloud.

name: Zen Pilgrimage/Death Gate/Moonglade Storage Aura I
Zen Pilgrimage: Return
description: Returns your spirit back to its body, returning you near to where you once were.\n\nLeaving Peak of Serenity will cancel Zen Pilgrimage: Return.

name: Grapple Weapon
description: You fire off a rope spear, grappling the target's weapons and shield, returning them to you for 5 sec.

name: Absolute Serenity
description: Celestial Conduit now prevents all crowd control for its duration.

name: Perpetual Paralysis
description: Paralysis range reduced by 5 yards, but spreads to 2 new enemies when removed.

name: Predestination
description: Killing a player with Touch of Death reduces the remaining cooldown of Touch of Karma by 60 sec.

name: Ride the Wind
description: Flying Serpent Kick clears all snares from you when used and forms a path of wind in its wake, causing all allies who stand in it to have 30% increased movement speed and to be immune to movement slowing effects.

name: Rising Dragon Sweep
description: Whirling Dragon Punch knocks enemies up into the air and causes them to fall slowly until they reach the ground.

name: Turbo Fists
description: Fists of Fury now reduces all targets movement speed by 90%, and you Parry all attacks while channelling Fists of Fury.

name: Wind Waker
description: Your movement enhancing abilities increases Windwalking on allies by 10%, stacking 2 additional times. Movement impairing effects are removed at 3 stacks.

name: Transcendence: Linked Spirits
description: Transcendence now tethers your spirit onto an ally for 1 hour. Use Transcendence: Transfer to teleport to your ally's location.

name: Against All Odds
description: Your agility is increased by 4%.

name: Airborne Rhythm
description: Slicing Winds now generates 1 Chi when cast.

name: Ancient Arts
description: Reduces the cooldown of Paralysis by 15 sec and the cooldown of Leg Sweep by 10 sec.

name: Ascension
description: Increases your maximum Chi by 1, maximum Energy by 20, and your Energy regeneration by 10%.

name: Bounding Agility
description: Roll and Chi Torpedo travel a small distance further.

name: Brawler's Intensity
description: The cooldown of Rising Sun Kick is reduced by 1.0 sec and the damage of Blackout Kick is increased by 12%.

name: Calming Presence
description: Reduces all damage taken by 3%.

name: Celerity
description: Reduces the cooldown of Roll by 5 sec and increases its maximum number of charges by 1.

name: Celestial Determination
description: While your Celestial is active, you cannot be slowed below 90% normal movement speed.

name: Chi Proficiency
description: Magical damage done increased by 5% and healing done increased by 5%.

name: Chi Transfer
description: Touch of Death now heals you for 50% of its damage done.

name: Chi-Ji's Swiftness
description: Your movement speed is increased by 75% during Celestial Conduit and by 15% for 3 sec after being assisted by any Celestial.

name: Combat Stance
description: The cooldown of Roll is decreased by 10%.

name: Combat Wisdom
description:
While out of combat, your Chi balances to 2 instead of depleting to empty.

 Expel Harm
Expel negative chi from your body, healing for 453 and dealing 10% of the amount healed as Nature damage to an enemy within 20 yards.

name: Combo Breaker
description: You have a 8% chance when you Tiger Palm to cause your next Blackout Kick to cost no Chi within 15 sec.

name: Communion With Wind
description: Strike of the Windlord and Whirling Dragon Punch have their cooldowns reduced by 5 sec and their damage is increased by 20%.

name: Courage of the White Tiger
description: Xuen claws your target for 118 Physical damage, healing a nearby ally for 100% of the damage done.\n\nInvoking a celestial guarantees your next cast activates this effect.

name: Crane Vortex
description: Spinning Crane Kick damage increased by 15% and its radius is increased by 15%.

name: Crashing Fists
description: The damage of Fists of Fury is increased by 20%.

name: Crashing Momentum
description: Targets you Roll through are snared by 40% for 5 sec.

name: Cyclone's Drift
description: You gain 10% more Haste from all sources of Haste.

name: Dance of Chi-Ji
description: Spending Chi has a chance to make your next Spinning Crane Kick cost no Chi.

name: Dance of the Wind
description: Your physical damage taken is reduced by 10% and an additional 10% every 4 sec until you receive a physical attack.

name: Drinking Horn Cover
description: The duration of Zenith is extended by 5 sec.

name: Dual Threat
description: Your auto attacks have a 30% chance to instead kick your target dealing 130 Physical damage. Damage increased while using a two-handed weapon.

name: Echo Technique
description: Casting Strike of the Windlord or Whirling Dragon Punch grants Blackout Kick!.

name: Efficient Training
description: Energy spenders deal an additional 20% damage.\nThe cooldown of Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox is reduced by 25 sec.

name: Elusive Mists
description: Reduces all damage taken by you and your target while channeling Soothing Mists by 6%.

name: Energy Burst
description: When you consume Blackout Kick!, you have a 100% chance to generate 1 Chi.

name: Energy Transfer
description: Successfully interrupting an enemy reduces the cooldown of Paralysis and Roll by 5 sec.

name: Escape from Reality
description: After you use Transcendence: Transfer, you can use Transcendence: Transfer again within 10 sec, ignoring its cooldown.

name: Expeditious Fortification
description: Fortifying Brew cooldown reduced by 30 sec.

name: Fast Feet
description: Rising Sun Kick deals 70% increased damage. Spinning Crane Kick deals 10% additional damage.

name: Fatal Touch
description: Touch of Death's cooldown is reduced by 90 sec.

name: Ferociousness
description: Critical Strike chance increased by 2%. This effect is increased by 100% while Xuen, the White Tiger is active.

name: Ferocity of Xuen
description: Increases all damage dealt by 2%.

name: Flow of Chi
description:
You gain a bonus effect based on your current health.

Above 90% health: Movement speed increased by 5%. This bonus stacks with similar effects.

Between 90% and 35% health: Damage taken reduced by 5%.

Below 35% health: Healing received increased by 10%.

name: Flowing Wisdom
description: Heart of the Jade Serpent increases your haste by 10% while active.

name: Flurry Strikes
description: Your auto attacks have a chance to generate 1-2 Flurry Charges. When you cast Keg Smash, unleash all Flurry Charges, dealing 21 Physical damage per charge.

name: Flurry of Xuen
description: Your spells and abilities have a chance to activate Flurry of Xuen, unleashing a barrage of deadly swipes to deal 192 Physical damage in a 10 yd cone, damage reduced beyond 5 targets.\n\nInvoking Xuen, the White Tiger activates Flurry of Xuen.

name: Glory of the Dawn
description: Rising Sun Kick has a chance equal to 100% of your haste to trigger a second time, dealing 17 Physical damage and restoring 1 Chi.

name: Grace of the Crane
description: Increases all healing taken by 6%.

name: Hardened Soles
description: Blackout Kick critical strike chance increased by 10% and critical damage increased by 18%.

name: Harmonic Combo
description: Fists of Fury's Chi cost is reduced by 1, but its damage is reduced by 10%.

name: Hasty Provocation
description: Provoked targets move towards you at 50% increased speed.

name: Healing Winds
description: Transcendence: Transfer immediately heals you for 10% of your maximum health.

name: High Impact
description: Enemies who die within 10 sec of being damaged by a Flurry Strike explode, dealing 35 physical damage to uncontrolled enemies within 8 yds.

name: Hit Combo
description: Each successive attack that triggers Combo Strikes in a row grants 1% increased damage, stacking up to 5 times.

name: Hurricane's Vault
description: Slicing Winds now costs 2 Chi to cast, but its damage is increased by 40%.

name: Improved Touch of Death
description: Touch of Death can now be used on targets with less than 15% health remaining, dealing 35% of your maximum health in damage.

name: Initiator's Edge
description: Movement speed is increased by 50% for the first 8 sec of combat.

name: Inner Compass
description:
You switch between alignments every 8 sec, increasing a corresponding secondary stat by 2%.

name: Inner Peace
description: Increases maximum Energy by 30. Tiger Palm's Energy cost reduced by 5.

name: Ironshell Brew
description: Increases your maximum health by an additional 10% and your damage taken is reduced by an additional 10% while Fortifying Brew is active.

name: Jade Ignition
description: Spinning Crane Kick detonates into a Chi Explosion, dealing 63 Nature damage to all enemies within 8 yards, reduced beyond 5 targets.

name: Jade Sanctuary
description: You heal for 10% of your maximum health instantly when you activate Celestial Conduit and receive 15% less damage for its duration. \n\nThis effect lingers for an additional 8 sec after Celestial Conduit ends.

name: Jade Walk
description: While out of combat, your movement speed is increased by 15%.

name: Jadefire Stomp
description: At the end of your Fists of Fury channel, you release a Jadefire Stomp, dealing 35 damage to 5 enemies in front of you and increasing your movement speed by 20% for 3 sec.

name: Knowledge of the Broken Temple
description: Strike of the Windlord and Whirling Dragon Punch grant 4 stacks of Teachings of the Monastery.\n\nTeachings of the Monastery can now stack up to 8 times.

name: Lighter Than Air
description: Roll causes you to become lighter than air, allowing you to double jump to dash forward a short distance once within 5 sec, but the cooldown of Roll is increased by 2 sec.

name: Martial Agility
description: Your melee attack speed is increased by 30%. This bonus is increased to 60% during Zenith.

name: Martial Instincts
description: Increases your Physical damage done by 5% and Avoidance increased by 2%.

name: Martial Precision
description: Your attacks penetrate 12% armor.

name: Memory of the Monastery
description: Tiger Palm's chance to activate Blackout Kick! is increased by 75% and Tiger Palm's damage is increased by 30%.

name: Meridian Strikes
description: The cooldown of Touch of Death is reduced by 45 sec.\n\nTouch of Death deals an additional 15% damage.

name: Momentum Boost
description: Fists of Fury's damage is increased by 100% of your haste and Fists of Fury does 10% more damage each time it deals damage, resetting when Fists of Fury ends.\n\nYour auto attack speed is increased by 60% for 8 sec after Fists of Fury ends.

name: Niuzao's Protection
description: Fortifying Brew grants you an absorb shield for 25% of your maximum health.

name: Obsidian Spiral
description: During Zenith, Blackout Kick generates 1 Chi.

name: One Versus Many
description:
Auto attack critical strikes generate double the amount of Flurry Charges.


Keg Smash damage increased by 35%.

name: Path of Jade
description: Increases the damage of Jadefire Stomp by 10% per target hit by that damage, up to a maximum of 50% additional damage.

name: Path of the Falling Star
description: Celestial Conduit's healing and damage is increased by 100% when striking a single target.\n\nEach addtional target reduces this bonus by 20%.

name: Peace and Prosperity
description: Reduces the cooldown of Ring of Peace by 5 sec and Song of Chi-Ji's cast time is reduced by 0.5 sec.

name: Predictive Training
description: When you dodge or parry an attack, reduce all damage taken by 10% for the next 6 sec.

name: Pressure Points
description: Paralysis now removes all Enrage effects from its target.

name: Pride of Pandaria
description: Flurry Strikes have 15% additional chance to critically strike.

name: Profound Rebuttal
description: Expel Harm's critical healing is increased by 50%.

name: Quick Footed
description: The duration of snare effects on you is reduced by 20%.

name: Reinvigoration
description: After Detox successfully removes an effect from an ally, their movement speed is increased by 30% for 5 sec.

description: Strike of the Windlord and Whirling Dragon Punch have a 100% chance to activate Dance of Chi-Ji.

name: Rising Star
description: Rising Sun Kick damage increased by 15% and critical strike damage increased by 10%.

name: Rushing Reflexes
description: Your heightened reflexes allow you to react swiftly to the presence of enemies, causing you to quickly lunge to the nearest enemy in front of you within 10 yards after you Roll.

name: Rushing Wind Kick
description:
After consuming Blackout Kick!, Rising Sun Kick has a 60% chance to become Rushing Wind Kick.

Rushing Wind Kick:
Kick up a powerful gust of wind, dealing 62 Nature damage in a 25 yd cone to enemies in front of you, split evenly among them. Damage is increased by 6% for each target hit, up to 30%.

name: Save Them All
description: Your healing is increased by up to 10%, based on the current health of your target. Lower health targets are healed for more.

name: Sequenced Strikes
description: You have a 100% chance to gain Blackout Kick! after consuming Dance of Chi-Ji.

name: Shado Over the Battlefield
description: Flurry Strikes deal 18 Nature damage to all enemies within 6 yds, reduced beyond 8 targets.

name: Shadowboxing Treads
description: Blackout Kick damage increased by 5% and strikes an additional 2 targets at 80% effectiveness.

name: Sharp Reflexes
description: Blackout Kick reduces the cooldown of Rising Sun Kick and Fists of Fury by 1.0 sec.

name: Silent Sanctuary
description: While no enemies are within 15 yds, you heal for 1,140 every 3 sec.

name: Singularly Focused Jade
description: Jadefire Stomp now strikes 1 target, but deals 300% increased damage and healing.

name: Skyfire Heel
description: Rising Sun Kick's critical strike chance is increased by 4% for each nearby enemy, up to 5 enemies.\n\n10% of Rising Sun Kick's damage splashes onto nearby enemies. Damage is reduced beyond 5 targets.

name: Spirit's Essence
description: Transcendence: Transfer snares targets within 10 yds by 70% for 4 sec when cast.

name: Spiritual Focus
description: The cooldown of Zenith is reduced by 20 sec.

name: Stampede of the Ancients
description: Strength of the Black Ox's effect is 400% more effective on your primary target.

name: Stand Ready
description: Activating Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox instantly grants 10 stacks of Flurry Strikes that trigger on your next attack at 70% effectiveness.

name: Stillstep Coil

description: Expel Harm's healing is increased by up to 100%, based on your missing health.

description: Strike of the Windlord and Whirling Dragon Punch grant you 4 stacks of Thunderfist and an additional stack for each additional enemy struck. \n\nThunderfist discharges upon melee strikes, dealing 56 Nature damage.

name: Tiger Fang
description: Your auto attack critical strike chance is increased by 15%.

name: Tiger Tail Sweep
description: Increases the range of Leg Sweep by 4 yds.

name: Tigereye Brew
description: Every 3 Chi spent generates Tigereye Brew. Zenith consumes up to 20 Tigereye Brew stacks to increase your critical strike chance for its duration by 1% per stack.\n\nGenerates quickly up to 10 stacks while out of combat and may generate up to a maximum of 30 stacks.

name: Touch of the Tiger
description: Tiger Palm damage increased by 50%.

name: Unity Within
description: Celestial Conduit can be recast once during its duration to call upon all of the August Celestials to assist you at 200% effectiveness.\n\nUnity Within is automatically cast when Celestial Conduit ends if not used before expiration.

name: Universal Energy
description: Your magical damage is increased by 8%.

name: Veteran's Eye
description: Haste increased by 5%.

name: Vigilant Watch
description: Blackout Kick deals an additional 30% critical damage.

name: Vigorous Expulsion
description: Expel Harm's healing increased by 5% and critical strike chance increased by 15%.

name: Vivacious Vivification
description: After casting Rising Sun Kick, your next Vivify becomes instant cast.\n\nThis effect also reduces the energy cost of Vivify by 75%.

name: Weapon of Wind
description: Your damage during Zenith is increased by 10%.

name: Weapons of the Wall
description: Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox's stomp damage increased by 20%.

name: Whirling Steel
description: When your health drops below 50%, summon Whirling Steel, increasing your parry chance and avoidance by 15% for 6 sec.\n\nThis effect can not occur more than once every 180 sec.

name: Wind's Reach
description: The range of Disable is increased by 5 yds.\n \nThe duration of Crashing Momentum is increased by 3 sec and its snare now reduces movement speed by an additional 20%.

name: Windwalking
description: You and your allies within 10 yards have 10% increased movement speed. Stacks with other similar effects.

name: Wisdom of the Wall
description: Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox causes Breath of Fire to launch 3 Flurry Strikes.

name: Xuen's Battlegear
description:
Rising Sun Kick critical strikes reduce the cooldown of Fists of Fury by 4 sec.

Spinning Crane Kick reduces the cooldown of Fists of Fury by 0.5 sec for each unique target struck, up to 2.5 sec.

description: Invoke Xuen, the White Tiger's damage is increased by 30% and its cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.
